design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER - task 1 (appeals_and_grievances, M=2). Round 2 (policy-task audit rework) applied; the text below states the round-2 design.

[Step 0 - draw and scope] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [6, 5, 6, 5]}. Root appeal_ext_stay_expedited_continued_stay takes 6 factors, appeal_ext_stay_reconsideration_second_level 6, appeal_ext_stay_charge_review_first_line 5, appeal_ext_stay_charge_review_joining 5. Occupied by task 0: the three late-filed Select line policies and their tools. Claimed here (disjoint): Allowable Charge Review open/join (file_allowable_charge_review_fa2a3df4, join_line_charge_review_4bed256c), second-level request (request_second_level_reconsideration_e1311ea5), telephone expedited reconsideration (take_expedited_reconsideration_1b494fd4, owner agent). After this task no extended policy or task tool is unclaimed.
Thesis: surface goal 'appeal my son's continued-stay denial urgently by phone' -> the expedited amount waits on (a) the stay's earlier reconsideration standing escalated (its still-denied days asked again are left out) and (b) the stay's highest-numbered paid day line standing joined to an Allowable Charge Review opened on an earlier paid line, when the stay was paid below the May daily rate (the days are then valued at the claimed rate); the second-level amount waits on (b) too; the joining waits on the opening review. Depth 3 hops (root -> second level -> joining -> opening); breadth: Select ledger (3 lines), referral authorizations and unit ledger (3 + 7 rows), two earlier cases, the tier's inpatient schedule.

[Why it is a good test] The mother asks for one thing. The agent must read the expedited rule's two waits, find that WAP-26-121907 (decided 2026-10-08) still awaits its next-level choice and that the stay's paid daily rate 1,312.00 is below the 1,480.00 of the May admission at the same hospital, work out from the other policies that the escalation write and the review writes bring those states about (a review opens on the claim's lowest-numbered disputed paid line; the further line joins it), and compute four payment-based amounts whose factors each move the number. The amounts are payment-based by declared overwrite of appeal_amount_in_dispute because the beneficiary's money at stake with a nonparticipating facility and other insurance is the TRICARE payment. No figure puts billed charges above an allowed amount into dispute: the billed-based rate (used only where no reference admission exists) divides a nonparticipating facility's billed daily amount by one plus the balance-billing limit, and the default daily rate is the stay's paid rate.

[Problem-tree card] Edges (all form state, all value_input):
E1 expedited -> second level, gate ex_days, sentence 'The days at issue on a continued-stay request are counted only after the stay's earlier medical necessity reconsideration stands escalated or its next-level window has closed.' (affirmative). Opening false: a327edf0-f81f-4ef3-82cf-ee8b371ca68a decided_partially_overturned, escalation_date empty, window to 2027-01-06. Only the second-level write sets a medical necessity case to escalated (the formal-review policy hears only Claim Factual Reconsiderations). Resolved by request_second_level_reconsideration_e1311ea5 (user).
E2 expedited -> joining, gate ex_daily_allowed, sentence 'Where the stay's paid daily rate falls below that of the patient's admission at the same facility in the past twelve months, the continued-stay amount is not valued until the last paid day line of the stay's claim stands joined to an Allowable Charge Review opened on an earlier paid line of that claim.' (negated). E3 second level -> joining, gate sl_daily_allowed, sentence 'Where the stay's paid daily rate falls below the facility's daily rate on the patient's admission of the past twelve months, the amount carried to the second level is not priced until the highest-numbered paid day line of the stay's claim stands joined to an Allowable Charge Review opened on an earlier paid line of that claim.' (negated). Condition of both = the sentence: a filed review on the highest-numbered paid line and another on an earlier paid line. Only the joining write produces it: the opening rule places a review only on the claim's lowest-numbered disputed paid line, so a review on a higher-numbered line beside an earlier review is made only by joining. Opening false: lines 1-2 paid at 1,312.00/day, no review. Resolved by join_line_charge_review_4bed256c (user).
E4 joining -> opening, gate jr_review_amount_so_far, sentence 'The amount recorded for a further paid line joining an Allowable Charge Review is not fixed until an Allowable Charge Review stands filed on an earlier paid line of the same claim.' (negated). Only the opening write creates the first review. Resolved by file_allowable_charge_review_fa2a3df4 (user).
Order: opening (11) -> joining (13) -> second level (15) -> expedited (17); every pair is ordered by an edge. The alternative of opening a review directly on line 2 is excluded by the opening rule's scope sentence. Deletion sensitivity (recomputed): without the escalation the expedited days are 20 and the amount 8,985.60; without the joining record the expedited amount is 2,519.04 and the second-level amount 3,778.56; without the opening review the joining computation has no review (raises). user_scenario raises neither prerequisite; both appear only in 'Only if the agent ...' branches. Tools check nothing.

[Base-invariant card] appeal_file (11, 13, 17): no open case on the subject (lines 1, 2 and request WRA-2026-1005-517 have none; the open-case lookups see only the two decided reconsiderations); tier and filing-deadline gates restated by declared overwrites (review subject = paid claim line, 90 days from the posted date 2026-10-13, last timely day 2027-01-11; expedited subject = the denied request, 3 days from the denial 2026-10-13, last timely day 2026-10-16, just-fails 2026-10-17); standing: parent of a minor. appeal_escalate (15): next_level_on_time anchored on decision_date 2026-10-08 + 90 days = 2027-01-06 inclusive; no minimum amount. Expedited criteria: ongoing inpatient stay, treating facility's urgent request on record.

[Business-object card] Stay: admission 2026-09-28 at Cascade Ridge Behavioral Hospital (non-network nonparticipating), authorization WRA-2026-0928-402 (21 requested, 7 granted, 2 more on appeal, valid through 2026-10-06, exhausted), claim WB26-1013-62055 lines 1 (7 days, allowed 9,184.00, OHI 6,428.80, cost share 551.04, TRICARE 2,204.16) and 2 (2 days, 2,624.00 / 1,836.80 / 157.44 / 629.76). Reference: May admission (WB26-0602-60117, 5 days, 7,400.00, OHI 5,180.00) under expired authorization WRA-2026-0511-118 (10 requested, 7 granted, 5 used, 2 released at expiry); its partial denial was reconsidered (WAP-26-108844, decided upheld 2026-06-10, window closed 2026-09-08). Continued-stay request WRA-2026-1005-517: 22 days from 2026-10-05, denied 2026-10-13. Overlaps: 2 requested days already covered (through 2026-10-06); 12 still-denied days of the earlier request (2026-10-07..2026-10-18) asked again.

[Factor cards] Tier schedule: TRICARE Select ADFM Group B (E-5 and Above) - non-network inpatient basis percent_of_allowed 20 percent; network basis per_admission_copay 76.00.
Opening review (line 1): cost-share percentage (param) 20 [baseline 0 -> 1,727.04]; cost-share basis (method) percent of allowed [baseline daily charge, 0.00/day on this tier -> 1,727.04]; claimed rate (param) 1,480.00 [baseline paid rate -> 0.00]; other-insurer payment (param) 6,428.80 [baseline 0 -> 6,083.84]; payment method (method) cost share on the net of the counted payment [baseline cost share on the whole -> 6,083.84]; result 940.80; whole baseline 6,979.84.
Joining (line 2): same kinds -> 268.80 + 940.80 = 1,209.60; baselines 1,434.24 / 1,434.24 / 940.80 / 2,679.04 / 2,679.04; whole 2,935.04.
Second level: percentage 20 [-> 6,739.20]; basis [-> 6,739.20]; daily allowed (param) 1,480.00 [baseline stay paid rate 1,312.00 -> 3,778.56]; daily OHI (param) 918.40 [-> 14,208.00]; payment method [-> 14,208.00]; days still covered (method) 12 [baseline 14 -> 6,289.92]; result 5,391.36; whole baseline 18,368.00 (14 days x 1,312.00).
Expedited: percentage [-> 4,492.80]; basis [-> 4,492.80]; daily allowed 1,480.00 [-> 2,519.04]; daily OHI 918.40 [-> 9,472.00]; payment method [-> 9,472.00]; days at issue (method) 8 [baseline 20 -> 8,985.60]; result 3,594.24; whole baseline 26,240.00 (20 days x 1,312.00).
Ladders: the inpatient percentage ladder's tiers are all reachable (non-network with a percentage basis: ADFM B, Retiree A and B; network with a lesser-of basis: Retiree A at 20; otherwise none); the inpatient basis ladder has a tier for each basis the Select schedule uses (percentage, lesser-of, per-admission copayment, per diem with minimum); the payment-method ladder is decided by the counted other-insurer payment against the allowed amount. Multi-source: the daily-allowed factors (joined review AND earlier admission) and the other-insurer factors (OHI on file AND payments shown). Cross-difficulty: select (ledger, schedule, enrollment) and referral (authorizations, unit ledger). Near-misses: the stay's billed daily amount (not used: a reference admission exists); the recorded 20,720.00 on the earlier case (filing-time allowed estimate); the 2 days granted on appeal (already covered); the older reconsideration WAP-26-108844 (decided in June, window closed) - the rules take the most recently filed/decided one, WAP-26-121907.

[Seed rationale] customers (Mateo), DEERS OHI gain, provider Cascade Ridge, Select ADFM Group B (E-5 and Above) enrollment (OHI on file), three authorizations and their 7 ledger rows, three paid lines (2026 family cost shares 444.00 + 551.04 + 157.44 = 1,152.48, below the 1,252.00 cap; deductible not applied to inpatient), the two decided reconsiderations and two documents of the September one. Sponsor's own record is not seeded (not read).

[Persona] Lucia, the worried mother in the hospital parking lot; volunteers only the urgent appeal request; gives Mateo's DBN, date of birth and sponsor SSN last four when asked; OHI and 'filing as his mother' when asked; agrees to the next-level request and the paid-amount review only after the agent raises them; completes handed forms herself; ends when the urgent appeal is taken.

[Standard solution] reads: find_customers(dbn) -> verify (DBN, DOB, SSN4) -> DEERS events -> Select enrollment -> authorizations -> unit ledger -> claim lines -> provider (by the facility id the claim lines carry) -> appeal cases -> case documents; writes: open review line 1 (940.80, user) -> join line 2 (1,209.60, user) -> second level on WAP-26-121907 (5,391.36, user) -> expedited case on WRA-2026-1005-517 (3,594.24, agent).

[Verification run] /tmp author scratch replayed the real tools on the seed and printed A 940.8, B 1209.6, C 5391.36, D 3594.24 with the per-factor baselines above; the skip run gives 2,519.04 for the expedited amount without the joining record. Gates on disk after round 2: see the difficulty worklog gate block. check_traceability not run: it needs the published KB.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the policy prose, schemas, persona and finder returns: the denied request is WRA-2026-1005-517; the earlier reconsideration is decided and not escalated (wait 1); the stay's paid rate is below May's (wait 2) -> open the review on line 1 (lowest-numbered disputed paid line), join line 2, escalate WAP-26-121907, then take the expedited case; amounts as above. Agrees with gold.

[Revisions] Round 3 (traceability): the provider lookup now follows the claim-line read, whose return carries the facility reference number it passes. r1: the second-level cap of one approval's units made the days factor decorative -> replaced by the cost-share percentage factor. r2: the facility is the requesting party of its concurrent-review requests (separate practice row dropped). r3: seeded the older June reconsideration (suite history maximum). Round 2 (audit G-1, G-2 observation, G-3, G-4, G-6, G-7, G-8, G-9, task-1 finding 1, O-4): the opening rule now places a review only on the claim's lowest-numbered disputed paid line and E2/E3 wait on the highest-numbered paid line standing joined to a review on an earlier line (conditions match the sentences, a single write produces the state, the one-review-on-line-2 path is no longer allowed); the daily-allowed tiers read that same joined state; the daily-allowed default is the stay's paid rate and the billed-based rate is reduced by the balance-billing limit for a nonparticipating facility; the stay amounts are stated only for a stay with a paid day line; the payment-method tiers no longer cite the always-true 'TRICARE pays second'; the inpatient percentage ladder now has three reachable tiers and the basis ladder a per-admission-copayment tier; schedule parameters are read from the enrollment the stay's lines were billed under. Scored values unchanged; second-level and expedited daily-allowed sensitivities now 3,778.56 / 2,519.04 and whole baselines 18,368.00 / 26,240.00.
user_scenario: You are Lucia Ferreira, the mother of Mateo Ferreira, who is sixteen. Mateo has been an inpatient at Cascade Ridge Behavioral Hospital in Tacoma since September 28, and you are calling from the hospital parking lot, worried and a little rushed. Yesterday the hospital told you that TRICARE denied the request to keep Mateo there longer, saying it is not medically necessary; his psychiatrist says he is not ready to come home. You want that denial appealed urgently, today, over the phone - you ask the agent to take the urgent appeal for you while you are on the call, as his mother. You do not know any dollar amounts and you never offer any. You give Mateo's details only when the agent asks: his DoD Benefits Number from his ID card is 11050462318, his date of birth is February 11, 2010 (2010-02-11), and the last four of his father's Social Security number are 5726. If more is asked, the family phone is 2535555318, the email on his record is mateo.ferreira.family@soundmail.net and the ZIP code is 98445. If asked about other insurance, you explain that your employer's plan covers Mateo and pays first. If asked who is filing, you are filing as his mother; nobody else represents him. Only if the agent brings up the reconsideration you filed back in September about the first days the authorization did not cover, and explains that it can go on to the next level and that this has to happen before the urgent appeal can be put in, you say yes, you want the rest of those days taken to the next level, and you make that request yourself when the agent hands it to you. Only if the agent tells you the days TRICARE already paid for this stay were paid at a lower daily rate than his stay at the same hospital in May, and that the paid amount needs to be put up for review first, you say you had no idea, that you pay the hospital what TRICARE does not, and that you want it reviewed; when handed the forms to open that review and to add another paid part of the same bill to it, you complete them yourself as his mother with the details the agent gives you. Whenever you complete something yourself, you tell the agent what the confirmation says. If the agent tells you an amount, you accept it. Once the agent confirms the urgent appeal has been taken, you thank them and hang up to go back inside.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: Order is forced by the edges: the opening review precedes the joining (joining reads the review's claim and amount); the joining precedes the second-level request and the expedited case (their daily allowed amount reads whether the highest-numbered paid line stands joined to a review on an earlier line); the second-level request precedes the expedited case (its days read the earlier case's escalated status). Placement is unique too: a review opens only on the claim's lowest-numbered disputed paid line (line 1), and line 2 can only join it, so opening a review directly on line 2 is not a route the rules allow.
